items.title: Inflation Is Running Above 3%. These 3 Dividend Stocks Have the Pricing Power to Keep Up.
items.summary: When inflation eats into your dividend's buying power, pricing power becomes the one trait separating stocks that keep up from those that quietly fall behind. Three consumer giants are charging more and still selling more, and the gap between them matters more than most investors realize.

items.title: Coca-Cola (KO) Weighs India Bottling IPO Through Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings
items.summary: Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) is reportedly weighing an IPO of its Indian bottling operations through Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings. The potential listing would involve Coca-Cola's company owned bottling assets in India, a key market within its global network. Management is said to be in the early stages of assessing options, including structure and timing, with no final decision disclosed. The exploration of an IPO for Hindustan Coca-Cola should not be the only factor shaping your view on KO today...
